text: With the same seeds 75-77 and data_seed 1, force margin at step 600 is 0.104-0.138 in 1500-step runs but 0.085-0.099 in 600-step runs. Is that gap caused by the lr schedule horizon (more lr left at step 600 in the longer run) or by non-determinism? A rerun of the 600-step config with an identical seed would tell these apart.
